title: Clickhouse - java.io.IOException: Reached end of input stream after reading ... of ... bytes
body:
I am getting the following error using the Trino Clickhouse connector
> java.io.IOException: Reached end of input stream after reading ... of ... bytes

I have a Clickhouse table like

|column_name | data_type|
|-----------|---------|
|date|date|
|advertisable_eid|varbinary|
|domain|varbinary|

If  I query over multiple dates the query fails with the above error. Example query
```sql
select 
date,
from_utf8(domain)
from <table>
where 
  from_utf8(advertisable_eid) = 'x'
  and from_utf8(domain) = 'y'
  and date(date) in (date'2023-06-01', date'2023-06-02') limit 10;
```

If I restrict this query to one date, it succeeds. A similar query succeeds if we directly query Clickhouse.

Thanks in advance for any help!

reporter
comments.body:
I think it is what @participant2 suggested. From the query logs, it looks like the date filter is not being pushed down into clickhouse, so it ends up querying the entire table.


The Trino query is
```sql
select 
date,
from_utf8(domain)
from <table>
where 
  from_utf8(advertisable_eid) = 'x'
  and from_utf8(domain) = 'y'
  and date(date) in (date'2023-06-01', date'2023-06-02') 
  limit 10
```

Here's what the query looks like in the `system.query_log` 
```sql
SELECT "date", "advertisable_eid", "domain" FROM "<table>"
```

Restricting to a specific date in Trino:
```sql
select 
date,
from_utf8(domain)
from <table>
where 
  from_utf8(advertisable_eid) = 'x'
  and from_utf8(domain) = 'y'
  and date(date) = date'2023-06-01'
  limit 10
```
And the corresponding query in the `system.query_log` 
```sql
SELECT "date", "advertisable_eid", "domain" 
FROM "<table>" 
WHERE ("date" >= '2023-06-01' AND "date" < '2023-06-02')
```

Before the connector is enhanced, an ugly workaround I can think of is to use union query. So `SELECT * FROM ch.default.pdtest WHERE date(date) IN (date'2023-04-06', date'2023-04-09')` becomes `SELECT * FROM ch.default.pdtest WHERE date(date) = date'2023-04-06' union all SELECT * FROM ch.default.pdtest WHERE date(date) = date'2023-04-09'` :<nick>:
